resources.string: Counts screen-on time, screen-ons and unlocks, app launches, notifications, screen rotations, unfolds (foldables), volume button presses, and charges by period. Shows the daily average and the change from the previous period.

Android keeps usage data for only a few days, so GOAT saves past data to a file on your device every day. Saved data never leaves your device. The 1-year and All views count from the day saving started.

Usage access is required. If Shizuku is connected, GOAT grants it automatically; otherwise, allow GOAT in [Open Usage Access]. Charge count and battery usage require Shizuku, and volume button count requires Volume Button Rotation to be on.
